answers.Q1: Near-universally. 93.1-99.4% of trades reaching a rung retrace by D; at D=1.00 ATR it is 98.8-99.4%. Retracement is not a state, it is what always happens.
answers.Q2: Usually. P(reclaim the full HWM) before terminal is 0.752-0.792 and P(new HWM) 0.743-0.782; R25 is 0.925-0.937.
answers.Q3: Fast. Median 5-6s to R25 and 55-57s to full HWM reclaim; p90 267-280s.
answers.Q4: Little. Median additional adverse excursion before recovery is well under 0.5 ATR, p90 ~1.10 and p95 ~1.44 ATR. Arms that never recover fall a median ~1.60 ATR further.
answers.Q5: No. Only 5 of 125 cells with >=3 horizons worsen monotonically -- roughly the chance rate for 4-point sequences -- and they do not form a neighbourhood.
answers.Q6: Nowhere reliably. Best of 96 rules is -0.098 ATR (CI -0.201 to -0.006); median -0.015. Only 1 of 96 CIs excludes zero, fewer than the ~4.8 expected by chance at 95%.
answers.Q7: No. The rule beats RETRACEMENT_ONLY by 0.002 ATR on average -- far under one tick. The recovery condition is decoration on the retracement.
answers.Q8: No. Simple drawdown, trade age, rung age and current return controls match the rule to within 0.008-0.019 ATR; each beats it outright in 21-38% of cells.
answers.Q9: Too many. The states intercept a median 13.3% of >=3 ATR runners and 21.2% of >=4 ATR runners, at a median loser:winner ratio of only 1.38 -- close to destroying winners and losers in equal measure.
answers.Q10: No. 40 of 48 side-split cells (83.3%) invert sign between LONG and SHORT; LONG frequently favours continuing where SHORT favours exiting.
answers.Q11: No knee. The few coherent-looking cells are isolated and no cell is consistent across all five years (best is 4 of 5).
answers.Q12: R4. Retracement is universal, recovery is the norm, the recovery condition adds nothing over the retracement, controls match it, sign inverts by side, and runner destruction is near-symmetric.
answers.Q13: Abandonment of this axis. Do not train an ML recovery/failure model and do not build a price-only exit architecture on this state. Local post-confirmation retracement geometry does not carry terminal deterioration.
